name: Reentrancy Drain
summary: Classic DAO-style reentrancy: attacker contract re-enters VictimLendingPool.withdraw() before the balance is decremented. Detector catches the signature and pauses the pool.
expectedOutcome: PendingTxEvent published. Detector matches REENTRANCY pattern (callGraphDepth > 3, recursive same-target). ThreatConfirmedEvent@2. defense-agent pauses before the second reentrant call drains.
requires: Attacker contract: ReentrancyAttacker.sol (not yet deployed in DeployLocal)

steps.text: Pause landed after 1 reentrant call. Loss ≈ 0.3% vs. total pool.
